title: High-fidelity entangling gates and nonlocal circuits with neutral atoms
what_it_changes: 99.85% two-qubit gate fidelity on neutral atoms advances hardware baseline for below-threshold QEC demonstrations.

title: Demonstration of a Multiplexing Trapped Ion Quantum Processing Unit
what_it_changes: Demonstrates multiplexing scalability for trapped-ion QPUs; addresses wiring bottleneck to fault-tolerant scale.

title: Ultra-high Q-factor superconducting tantalum resonators on 300 mm Si wafers
what_it_changes: Demonstrates industrial-scale ultra-high-Q superconducting resonators (>40M median, >60M peak) on 300mm wafers, enabling hardware-efficient bosonic error correction and scaling.

title: High-Fidelity Hole Spin Qubits Reveal Quadrupolar Nuclear-Bath Dynamics in Isotopically Purified Planar Germanium
what_it_changes: Demonstrates 99.9% single-qubit Ge-hole fidelity via isotopic purification, advancing hardware records for spin-qubit platform.

title: High-Precision Calibration Workflow Achieves Above $99.9\%$ CZ Gate Fidelity on a Scalable Superconducting Processor
what_it_changes: Demonstrates 99.9% CZ fidelity on 84-qubit processor; advances two-qubit gate benchmark supporting FTQC feasibility.

title: Fault-tolerant quantum computation with static atomic buses
what_it_changes: Demonstrates logical-qubit error correction and gate operations on neutral-atom hardware with simulated >10× improvement over prior architectures.

title: Josephson spectroscopy study of kagome superconductors toward the deep point-contact regime
what_it_changes: Demonstrates zero-bias conductance saturation in point-contact regime mimics Majorana signatures; cautions against misinterpretation in topological-qubit searches.

title: Superconducting PdTe Thin Film Via Topotactic Transformation, Toward Topological Superconductors
what_it_changes: Demonstrates high-quality superconducting PdTe thin films via MBE; enables experimental platforms for Majorana detection but does not yet evidence MZMs.

title: Exposing impostor Majorana zero modes through atomic-scale shot-noise
what_it_changes: Demonstrates shot-noise method to distinguish trivial zero-bias peaks from true Majorana modes; directly addresses impostor problem in Fe(Se,Te).

title: Experimental Evidence of Fractional Entropy in Critical Kondo Systems
what_it_changes: Independent thermodynamic evidence of non-Abelian anyons (Majorana, Fibonacci) via fractional entropy in Kondo systems.

title: Probing PbTe-Pb nanowire devices with radio-frequency reflectometry
what_it_changes: Demonstrates rf reflectometry compatibility with PbTe-Pb nanowires under magnetic fields; advances measurement capability for topological-qubit platforms.

title: Fabry-Perot Interference, g-factor Anisotropy, and Gate-Tunable Quantum dot in Chiral Tellurium Nanowires
what_it_changes: Demonstrates Majorana-platform prerequisites (spin-orbit gap, g-factor anisotropy, quantum coherence) in elemental tellurium; not Majorana detection but materials foundation.

title: Distinguishing Majorana zero modes from trivial defect states on the surface of the iron-based superconductor Fe(Te,Se)
what_it_changes: Independent experimental replication showing Fe(Te,Se) zero modes are trivial Yu-Shiba-Rusinov states, not Majoranas—directly challenges topological-superconductor claim.

title: Picosecond Schrödinger cat states for ultrafast optical quantum processing
what_it_changes: Demonstrates high-rate non-Gaussian state generation at picosecond timescales, addressing temporal-mode bottleneck for fault-tolerant photonic QC.

title: Industry-ready spin-photon interfaces for hybrid photonic quantum computing
what_it_changes: Demonstrates production-line QD devices with near-unity photon purity, multi-photon entanglement, and path toward fault-tolerance loss thresholds.

title: Integrated Photon-Memory Entanglement Generation using Dual Photonic Resonators
what_it_changes: First integrated photon-memory entanglement on chip; demonstrates scalable quantum-repeater building block with published loss budgets and multimode storage capacity.

title: Tantalum-Encapsulated Niobium Superconducting Resonators: High Internal Quality Factor and Improved Temporal Stability via Surface Passivation
what_it_changes: Demonstrates fab control of TLS density via Ta encapsulation; shows scaling path and temporal stability data.

title: Operating a bistable qubit
what_it_changes: Demonstrates adaptive mitigation of TLS-induced dephasing in superconducting qubits with 77% error reduction; addresses whether TLS defects are a fundamental scaling wall.

title: Readout failures in superconducting qubits due to TLS-defects in tunnel junctions
what_it_changes: Demonstrates TLS-readout resonator coupling as a scaling mechanism limiting qubit fidelity; supports TLS as a fundamental scaling wall.

title: Interface Piezoelectric Loss in Superconducting Qubits
what_it_changes: Identifies interface piezoelectricity as distinct loss channel competing with/exceeding TLS at high frequencies; experimental evidence for new scaling constraint.

title: Multi-Qubit Entanglement of Unit Cell Pairs in SiMOS
what_it_changes: SiMOS 4-qubit multi-unit-cell coupling with 99%+ fidelities and preserved entanglement lifetime advances silicon scalability beyond isolated DQD units.

title: Non-Local and Non-Markovian Effects of a Microscopic Two-Level Defect in Superconducting Quantum Circuits
what_it_changes: Demonstrates tunable TLS coupling in scalable architecture; non-Markovian dynamics complicate error-correction models.

title: Surface Platinum Alloying for Passivation of Oxide Interfaces on Superconducting Niobium Films
what_it_changes: Demonstrates fab-level control of TLS density via Pt alloying; directly addresses surface-oxide scaling wall.

title: Towards Ultra-High-Rate Quantum Error Correction with Reconfigurable Atom Arrays
what_it_changes: Demonstrates ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes (>1/2 encoding) with sub-threshold logical error rates on neutral atoms, directly addressing overhead reduction.

title: Networked Realization of Quantum LDPC Codes
what_it_changes: First circuit-level noise study of networked bivariate bicycle qLDPC codes; quantifies overhead under practical constraints.

title: CAbLECAR: efficiently scheduling QLDPC codes on a tileable spin qubit chip with shuttling
what_it_changes: Circuit-level QLDPC scheduling on silicon spin qubits; identifies codes reducing logical error rates vs surface codes; quantifies overhead via shuttling range extension.

title: A Scalable FPGA Architecture for Real-Time Decoding of Quantum LDPC Codes Using GARI
what_it_changes: First multi-core FPGA decoder for qLDPC under correlated errors; 6× resource reduction advances practical overhead benchmarking.

title: Mitigating Classical Resource Costs in Quantum Error Correction via Generalized qLDPC Predecoding
what_it_changes: Demonstrates practical predecoding + hardware design reducing qLDPC decoder utilization 3,963x; scales to 36k–360k logical qubits on cryogenic ASIC.

title: Space-Time Tradeoffs of Pauli-Based Computation in Distributed qLDPC Architectures
what_it_changes: Quantifies qLDPC execution-time overhead vs surface code in distributed architecture; demonstrates order-of-magnitude speedup with large blocks.

title: Distributed Quantum Error Correction with Bivariate Bicycle Codes in a Modular Architecture
what_it_changes: Demonstrates distributed BB code logical error rates and pseudo-threshold on modular hardware; measures practical qLDPC overhead scaling.

title: A Resource Comparison of Logical T-State Preparation
what_it_changes: Systematizes T-state preparation costs across distillation/cultivation/code-switching; clarifies overhead trade-offs under standardized comparison.

title: Hardware-Tailored Resource Estimation for Magic-State Distillation on Silicon Spin Qubits
what_it_changes: Quantifies magic-state distillation overhead on silicon; biased codes achieve 3× footprint reduction vs surface code.

title: Evolutionary Discovery of Bivariate Bicycle Codes with LLM-Guided Search
what_it_changes: Discovers new high-performing qLDPC codes; indecomposable [[288,16,12]] and codes with k=50, d=8 improve finite-length overhead data.

title: Full Extractors for Logical Processing in Hypergraph Product Codes
what_it_changes: Demonstrates full logical processing on HGP qLDPC codes with 50–80% size vs. base code; achieves 10⁻⁶ logical error at distance 10.

title: Breakeven demonstration of quantum low-density parity-check codes
what_it_changes: First experimental breakeven qLDPC code; 9× logical error-rate improvement over prior solid-state implementation.

title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
what_it_changes: Demonstrates new qLDPC code families with measured overhead via BP+OSD decoding under realistic noise.

title: Fast and Parallel High-Rate STAR Architecture for Megaquop Quantum Simulation
what_it_changes: High-rate QEC code integration achieves ~5.5× space reduction vs surface code; demonstrates co-designed algorithm-code-hardware overhead optimization.

title: Strictly Local Tile-Code Architectures on Two-Dimensional Planar Lattices
what_it_changes: Demonstrates routed tile-code overhead <surface-code at p<0.08%; validates qLDPC scaling under realistic connectivity constraints.

title: Fast and accurate AI-based pre-decoders for surface codes
what_it_changes: Demonstrates scalable real-time surface-code decoding at O(1 μs) with LER improvements over standard decoders.

title: Fault-Tolerant Error Detection Above Break-Even for Multi-Qubit Gates
what_it_changes: Demonstrates fault-tolerant error detection above break-even on trapped-ion hardware; advances real-device QEC validation.

title: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing with Trapped Ions: The Walking Cat Architecture
what_it_changes: LDPC-based trapped-ion FT architecture with 110 logical qubits, 2,514 physicals, Hamiltonian-sim utility in ~1 month.

title: High-performance cellular automaton decoders for quantum repetition and toric code
what_it_changes: Demonstrates scalable real-time QEC decoder with threshold ~7.5% and subthreshold scaling; advances practical error-correction architecture feasibility.

title: MCMit: Mid-Circuit Measurement Error Mitigation
what_it_changes: Demonstrates measured QEC logical error reduction (1.2–9.4×) via mid-circuit measurement error mitigation on hardware.

title: Real-time Surface-Code Error Correction Using an FPGA-based Neural-Network Decoder
what_it_changes: Demonstrates real-time surface-code QEC (distance-3) with closed-loop feedback on superconducting hardware; validates hardware-integrated decoder architecture for scalable fault tolerance.

title: Surface-Code Thresholds and Qubit Footprints in Shuttling-Based Spin-Qubit Railways
what_it_changes: Demonstrates surface-code threshold and footprint scaling on silicon spin qubits with circuit-level noise; achieves Megaquop distance-7 code at p=10^−3 error rate.

title: Error Correction of Beamsplitter-Generated Entangled GKP States
what_it_changes: First experimental demonstration of entangled GKP qubits with QEC extension; advances trapped-ion bosonic code roadmap.

title: Benchmarking a machine-learning differential equations solver on a neutral-atom logical processor
what_it_changes: Demonstrates logical-qubit advantage in end-to-end ML application; validates fault-tolerant overhead trade-offs experimentally.

title: Real-Time Quantum Error Correction System Stack: Architecture, Algorithms, and Engineering Practice
what_it_changes: Quantifies real-time QEC engineering gaps; benchmarks decoders for surface/qLDPC; identifies system-level bottlenecks beyond algorithm speed.

title: Quantum error correction with the toric code
what_it_changes: First scalable toric-code logical-qubit demo on neutral atoms with 90 syndrome cycles, distance-dependent error suppression.

title: A superconducting surface-code processor with lattice-surgery logical operations
what_it_changes: First experimental demonstration of below-threshold surface-code logical operations with multi-cycle error suppression on real hardware.

title: Efficient Magic State Factory Via Transversal Non-Clifford Gate
what_it_changes: End-to-end magic-state factory simulations at distance d=5 with code switching; resource comparison against cultivation methods.

title: Cultivating logical catalysts for fault-tolerant dyadic phase rotations
what_it_changes: Demonstrates fault-tolerant logical-qubit phase gates with error-corrected scaling; advances offline magic-state cultivation toward FTQC resource efficiency.

title: LUCI on IBM Hardware: Error Suppression with Almost Half Syndrome Density
what_it_changes: Demonstrates logical-qubit error suppression on real hardware with reduced syndrome overhead; validates dynamic-code QEC beyond theory.

title: Genuine Multipartite Entanglement between Logical Qubits via Cross-Code Lattice Surgery
what_it_changes: First experimental demonstration of logical-qubit universal gates via lattice surgery on real hardware; advances fault-tolerant QEC building blocks.

title: Quantum error correction of a grid-state qubit with state preparation and measurement errors below $10^{-3}$
what_it_changes: Demonstrates below-threshold QEC performance in grid-state qubits; SPAM errors reduced 100× to sub-10⁻³, enabling practical logical-qubit operation.

title: Tensor network surrogate models for variational quantum computation
what_it_changes: Tensor-network classical simulation successfully benchmarks QAOA on spin-glass; demonstrates parameter-transfer limits and feasibility scaling.

title: Truncated Wigner dynamics of biclique quantum spin glasses
what_it_changes: TWA classical method reproduces quantum spin-glass dynamics and critical exponents; scales to tens of thousands of qubits.

title: Estimating The Energy Consumption of Quantum Computing from A Full System Aspect
what_it_changes: First full-stack joules-per-answer model for NISQ and FTQC; quantifies energy breakdown by regime.

title: Unveiling Energetic Advantage in Superconducting Cat-Qubits Quantum Computation
what_it_changes: Provides full-stack energy consumption model and scaling analysis for superconducting cat-qubit systems with error correction; estimates quantum energetic advantage threshold at >26 qubits.

title: Ground-state energies of Ising models calculated using the samples from a quantum computer that simulates short-time evolution
what_it_changes: Demonstrates Ising ground-state calculation at 63 qubits on real hardware; quantifies error scaling and utility boundary.

title: Utility-scale quantum experiments using dynamic circuits to address collective dissipation in interacting qubits
what_it_changes: Demonstrates utility-scale dissipative-dynamics simulation on 86 qubits with validated classical comparison; addresses classical reproducibility dispute.
